content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to use [product_name] for building management system applications?
It’s difficult to provide a definitive answer without more detailed information. Please clarify your specific requirements and what exactly you aim to achieve.

I have a building that requires a smoke ventilation system consisting of two fans, some dampers, and sensors for controlling the system. I want to know if [product_name] can be used for monitoring and configuration of this setup.

As mentioned earlier, a general statement isn't possible without a clearer project overview, and the information provided so far is limited. [product_name] with [version_no] supports 24 digital inputs, 20 digital outputs, 8 analog inputs, and 8 analog outputs. If your project exceeds these specifications, additional [product_name] units would be required, which can exchange status data over Ethernet. For visualization, the standard web server feature allows for basic virtual message display and control functionality via a browser interface. The latest [version_no] also allows custom web pages using a free add-on ([product_name] Web Editor). For more advanced visualization needs, dedicated visualization software that integrates with [product_name] might be needed.
